integrity: Original hyperbolic-tile source is cited and used without modification. Complete mathematical argument and optional finite numerical regression are supplied; numerical tests are not substituted for an infinite proof. Independent validation has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Determines the sharp radius for centers restricted to the reflection axis and proves that every unrestricted largest-disk center is off-axis for even q; it does not determine the unrestricted radius or odd-q behavior.
title: Symmetry-breaking largest inscribed disks in the geodesic Zare monotiles
